about_summary.title: About Us
about_summary.body: Onesky is a professional medical device company integrating R&D, production, sales, and after-sales service. Headquartered in Hong Kong, it operates multiple wholly-owned subsidiaries in Mainland China, with its business focused on two core sectors: the R&D and production of its own proprietary brands, and the exclusive distribution of high-end international products.
